name: db_collections
description: List the database's collections with their record counts and last update time. The database persists between runs.

name: db_find
description: Find records in a collection. Filter with `where` on any field (dot paths reach nested fields; id, created_at and updated_at are built in), sort with `order_by`, and page with `limit`/`offset`. Returns the total match count and the page of records.

additionalProperties.description: A value (equals) or an object of operators: eq, ne, in, nin, lt, lte, gt, gte, exists (true/false), contains (case-insensitive substring).

where.description: Field conditions, all of which must match. Example: {"status": {"in": ["new", "sent"]}, "last_sent_at": {"lt": "2026-09-25"}}.

name: db_get
description: Get records by id from a collection. Reports ids that don't exist.

name: db_upsert
description: Create or update up to 100 records in one call; all changes apply or none do. For each record: `set` merges fields (a new record is created if the id is new), `unset` removes fields, and `append` adds a value to the end of a list field (created if missing), e.g. to add a comment to a history. Values can be any JSON. Use stable ids that identify the thing itself (an email address, a URL, an external id), so records are not duplicated.

collection.description: Collection name: lowercase letters, digits and _.

append.description: field -> value to append to that list field.

name: db_delete
description: Delete records by id. Prefer updating a status field over deleting, so history is kept.
